questions.text: On which date did India become independent?
questions.explanation: India gained independence from British rule on 15 August 1947.

questions.text: Who was independent India's first Prime Minister?
questions.explanation: Jawaharlal Nehru served as India's first Prime Minister.

questions.text: Who delivered the 'Tryst with Destiny' speech?
questions.explanation: Nehru delivered the speech at midnight on 14–15 August 1947.

questions.text: Where is the national Independence Day address traditionally delivered?
questions.explanation: The Prime Minister addresses the nation from Delhi's Red Fort.

questions.text: Who hoists the national flag at the Red Fort on Independence Day?
questions.explanation: The Prime Minister hoists the flag and addresses the nation.

questions.text: When was India's national flag adopted by the Constituent Assembly?
questions.explanation: The present form of the national flag was adopted on 22 July 1947.

questions.text: How many spokes are in the Ashoka Chakra?
questions.explanation: The navy-blue Ashoka Chakra has 24 spokes.

questions.text: In which year did the Dandi March take place?
questions.explanation: Gandhi led the Dandi March in 1930.

questions.text: What did the Dandi March protest?
questions.explanation: The march challenged the British monopoly and tax on salt.

questions.text: In which year was the Quit India Movement launched?
questions.explanation: The Quit India Movement began in August 1942.

questions.text: Jallianwala Bagh is located in which city?
questions.explanation: Jallianwala Bagh is in Amritsar, Punjab.
Jana Gana Mana is the National Anthem of India.
Rabindranath Tagore composed Jana Gana Mana.

questions.text: 15 August 2026 marks which Independence Day of India?
questions.explanation: 2026 marks India's 80th Independence Day, counting 1947 as the first observance.

questions.text: Which patriotic song completes 150 years in 2026?
questions.explanation: Vande Mataram was composed in 1876, making 2026 its 150th year.
